claim_ceiling: This registry is a research index. It does not qualify a method, machine, site, physical model, safety case, construction design, or operational use.

evidence_scale.label: Concept
evidence_scale.meaning: Plausible mechanism or proposal; no adequate experimental demonstration identified.

evidence_scale.label: Analytical_or_small_specimen
evidence_scale.meaning: Theory, simulation, or initial small-specimen evidence.

evidence_scale.label: Controlled_experimental_fixture
evidence_scale.meaning: Controlled laboratory apparatus with measured response.

evidence_scale.label: Field_or_pilot
evidence_scale.meaning: Borehole, mine, quarry, or TBM pilot; full production boundary may remain incomplete.

evidence_scale.label: Sustained_production
evidence_scale.meaning: Repeated useful duty cycles with full-cycle energy, maintenance, reliability, and acceptance evidence.

evidence_scale.label: Independent_transfer
evidence_scale.meaning: Independent replication across sites, machines, and relevant geological cohorts.

evidence_rules: Evidence tiers are assigned per application, not globally to a technology name.
A borehole demonstration is not evidence for large-diameter tunnel-face production.
A cutting-only energy reduction is not a full-cycle productivity or lifecycle-cost result.
Laboratory, company-reported, peer-reviewed field, archaeological, and interpretive evidence remain distinct.
Unknown application scope must be recorded as not_demonstrated, not inferred from another application.

application_evidence.basis: Established industrial method family; exact machine/ground envelope still requires project-specific qualification.
Established industrial method family; task and block-quality boundaries differ from tunnel advance.

not_demonstrated: One universal performance envelope for all granite and basalt.

application_evidence.basis: Established industrial method family; comparisons require declared blast, ventilation, fragmentation, support, and cycle boundaries.

not_demonstrated: A universal substitute for mechanical continuous excavation.

application_evidence.basis: Laboratory and field/industrial TBM studies exist; heating/cooling burden and sustained-operation effects remain important.

not_demonstrated: Standalone large-fragment detachment in hard granite across general field conditions.

application_evidence.basis: 2025 controlled drilling study reports underwater low-energy pulses (~80 J/pulse), cracks up to 9.4 mm, up to 56% lower specific cutting energy before PDC mechanical cutting, and cracking tests at elevated pressure (~300 atm). This is cutting-energy evidence, not a full-cycle mine productivity result.

2026 review surveys granite and other rock experiments but identifies disagreement between EHD shockwave and electric-discharge arc mechanisms, sensitivity to fluid/polarity/pulse settings, limited high-pressure modelling, and absence of standardized benchmarks.

not_demonstrated: Sustained high-pressure downhole operation or production-scale tunnel excavation.

application_evidence.basis: Keep distinct from pulsed electrical discharge and gyrotron methods; this registry found no production-scale granite/basalt tunnelling evidence.

not_demonstrated: A qualified production hard-rock tunnel or quarry system.

application_evidence.basis: ETH modelling and combined thermo-mechanical laboratory/field proof-of-concept exist; not a sustained production tunnel face.

not_demonstrated: A transferable full-cycle granite/basalt tunnel production advantage.

application_evidence.basis: MIT/MITEI reported a 118 m field borehole and company-reported demonstration speed up to 5 m/h in 2025; treat as a specific borehole demonstration.

not_demonstrated: Large-diameter tunnel-face production, heterogeneous deep-hole transfer, or independently replicated full-cycle economics.

application_evidence.basis: Laboratory tests and a 2026 review describe pre-weakening and reduced subsequent mechanical cutting loads for selected specimen/configuration sets.

not_demonstrated: Universal geology transfer or a complete production system with conversion, shielding, cooling and ventilation costs.

application_evidence.basis: Research and conceptual diagrams exist; no sustained large-scale granite/basalt tunnel production result identified in this review.

not_demonstrated: Production-scale tunnel face performance, optical delivery through dusty/steamy boreholes, and lifecycle cost.

application_evidence.basis: Sonic drilling is used in field sampling; this does not imply a hard-rock production-tunnelling capability.
Published analytical/dynamic rock-breaking model; not a full-scale hard-granite tunnel trial.

not_demonstrated: Sustained production advance in massive granite/basalt using resonance alone.

application_evidence.basis: 2025 prototype reports stable 43 micrometre amplitude and speed gains for the tested sandstone/limestone conditions.

not_demonstrated: Granite or basalt performance at a representative hard-rock cutting scale.

application_evidence.basis: 2025 laboratory study reports exposure-time-dependent micro/macrocracking and strength changes in tested samples.

not_demonstrated: Continuous field excavation or net-energy advantage after cryogen production, storage, transport and boil-off.

application_evidence.basis: Commercial/static splitting methods and engineering literature exist; dwell time and borehole geometry make it distinct from continuous TBM production.

not_demonstrated: High-throughput continuous tunnel-face removal.

application_evidence.basis: Quarry artefacts and replicated work; one 2023 photogrammetric experiment measured about 216 cm3/h at 85 hits/minute with a 3.47 kg pounder.

not_demonstrated: The complete historical workflow for every monument or a single-method explanation of the unfinished obelisk.

application_evidence.basis: Museum research describes abrasive particulates in saws/core drills and quartz-rich traces in ancient drill holes; Egyptian emery use remains debated.

not_demonstrated: The use of a particular abrasive such as emery in every Egyptian quarry.

application_evidence.basis: Quarry faces and workshop evidence document extraction and shaping of basalt with stone tools.

not_demonstrated: Transfer to other basalt types, monumental block sizes or unrelated quarry contexts.

application_evidence.basis: 2026 paper reports small specimen replication and proposes an interpretation of text/imagery; no quarry residue is reported and historical attribution remains unconfirmed.

not_demonstrated: Use at the Aswan Unfinished Obelisk, full trench scale, or consensus historical attribution.

application_evidence.basis: A 2024 granite laboratory study comparing pulsed versus constant plasma jet reports 54.74% lower specific energy, 17.81% higher penetration rate and 50.06% lower electrode wear in its own test boundary. A 2025 thermal study identifies a spalling-to-melting transition and a heat-affected region. These are laboratory comparisons, not a production tunnel result.

not_demonstrated: Sustained production-scale granite or basalt tunnel excavation.
A full-cycle comparison including power conversion, cooling, ventilation, debris removal and maintenance.

application_evidence.basis: 2021 review describes high-voltage pulse applications in mineral liberation, pre-weakening and pre-concentration; it also identifies energy, equipment wear, water processing and throughput challenges. A 2025 review surveys discharge-parameter optimization and heterogeneity effects. Treat as a distinct mineral-processing pathway, not in-situ tunnel excavation.

not_demonstrated: A general replacement for conventional tunnel-face excavation.
A universally beneficial energy or recovery gain across ores and feed-size distributions.

application_evidence.basis: A 2026 Fushen-1 field test in altered granite above 180 C reports a 33 m ATCP test interval at 5.32 m/h versus 1.93 m/h in an adjacent 164 m conventional rotary interval; the paper reports 175.65% higher ROP and 63.68% lower MSE. Adjacent intervals are not a randomized matched trial; retain geology/interval/operating confounding and do not infer a transferable causal effect.

not_demonstrated: Matched randomized transfer across granite/basalt cohorts, depths, temperatures and equipment configurations.
An equivalent productivity gain in large-diameter tunnel-face excavation.
Lifecycle-cost improvement after tool, pump, maintenance and full-cycle accounting.

application_evidence.basis: A 2025 experimental/simulation study reports an optimized cone-hybrid cutter configuration with 70.81% lower comprehensive specific fragmentation energy than its minimum mechanical baseline and 7.4% lower than a laser-assisted triple-cylinder configuration. This is configuration-specific fragmentation-energy evidence, not a whole-rig electrical or field productivity result.

not_demonstrated: Sustained field operation in granite or basalt with complete optical source, cooling, ventilation and auxiliary energy accounting.
A transferable result for large TBM disc-cutter faces or unrelated cutter geometry.

application_evidence.basis: A 2026 full-scale linear cutting-rig study tests ODC speed ratio and cutting depth on red sandstone (UCS 61.33 MPa). It measures thrust, torque, specific energy and fragment size; increased oscillation has competing cutting-energy and downstream-crushing-energy effects. This is not a granite/basalt test.

The 2026 paper reports that the Komatsu MC51 using ODC technology completed an underground passage project in Sydney in 2025. This is reported application evidence, not an independently published hard-granite performance dataset.

not_demonstrated: Matched full-scale granite and basalt comparisons against conventional disc cutters.
Transfer of red-sandstone cutting-force and fragment-size findings into highly abrasive hard rock.
Lifecycle cost and cutter life under a complete tunnel project boundary.
